overview_description.description: Fintopio is a modern Web3 fintech platform that combines CeFi (Centralized Finance) and DeFi (Decentralized Finance) into a seamless digital wallet experience. The platform is designed to simplify cryptocurrency payments, asset management, and blockchain interactions across Telegram, web, iOS, and Android applications.

product.name: Fintopio Wallet
product.description: A digital wallet that integrates centralized finance (CeFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi) functionalities, allowing users to switch instantly between custodial and non-custodial modes.

product.name: Smart Send
product.description: A service to send cryptocurrency using social media usernames through the Fintopio app or Telegram chat.

product.name: Vouchers & Gifting
product.description: A feature that enables sending cryptocurrency as gifts to anyone, including recipients without a Fintopio wallet.
